nodes.label: I-4 — WP-CLI bulk paths (closed 2026-08-16)
nodes.rationale: Unit 10 had exercised optimize --id, restore --id, stats, diagnostics, logs and requeue live. What remained were the bulk paths - optimize --all, --dry-run, restore --all, --limit and --batch - which is the route the plugin actually recommends for large libraries. Closed by testing, with no unit; the reasoning lives in issues.md itself. Evidence is one site, which the tracker records as a limit rather than hiding.

nodes.label: I-8 — Backup manifest can become unreachable
nodes.rationale: Half closed in Unit 10: manifest_is_intact() checks every named file on disk so Restore no longer advertises canRestore on a backup that would fail. What remains is a recoverability gap - backup_path is JSON in a TEXT column with nothing reconciling it against the directory.

nodes.label: I-9 — Time-based backup expiry untested with aged data
An empty issues list means nobody has looked
nodes.rationale: Unit 10 closed fourteen defects that were not listed in issues.md, three of which destroyed user data, and every one was found by reading the conversion path rather than by any test or any tracked entry.
